style: stylised cartoon game model: chunky exaggerated proportions, smooth rounded forms with clean bevels, bold saturated colours with soft hand-painted shading, friendly and a little goofy; no pixelation, no hard facets, no realism
texture_rule: Hand-painted cartoon textures at 512 to 1024 px: flat base colours, soft gradient shading, a few bold painted details, no photo detail and no visible pixels.

routes.exact: Author in Blender and upload through Open Cloud (ROBLOX_API_KEY). Used where shape or rigging must be exact: hero limb sets, terrain chunks, chest with a separate lid, portal, weapons.
routes.generated: Studio generate_mesh with explicit part names, from a Forge concept image that was judged first; retexture with generate_texture using the concept as the style hint. Used for organic assets: enemies, bosses, head gear, statues, trees.
routes.probed: AssetService:CreateAssetAsync returned 'not available yet' on 2026-10-12, so script-built meshes cannot be published from inside Studio.

judging: Every mesh is rendered beside the matching reference still in design/refs and compared for silhouette, proportions, scale and colour role, and against the cartoon style sheet for style, before it is accepted.
note: roblox-3d-model. Colour: PAINT it (paint_texture.py), never project it.
